title: Design Powerhouse Super Session: Maximizing Your Creativity
note: Placeholder transcript for the AI Week demo, not a real transcription. Replace via generate_transcripts.py once ffmpeg + an OpenAI/Whisper key are available.

segments.text: Panel of designers introduces the idea of a 'combined toolkit' - moving concepting, editing, and prototyping across Photoshop, Illustrator, and Firefly instead of staying siloed in one app.
Live demo of using Generative Fill to explore concept directions quickly, then refining the chosen direction by hand rather than shipping the generated output directly.
Automating repetitive production work - batch resizing, asset export presets, and actions - to protect time for the actual creative decisions.
Building a reusable color and typography system so a campaign stays consistent across social, web, and print without redoing decisions for every asset.
Cross-team collaboration: handing off editable source files to motion and web teams, and the naming/versioning conventions that keep handoffs from breaking.
How to present concepts to clients or stakeholders - framing 2-3 directions with a clear rationale each, instead of one polished option with no context.
A segment on staying current: how the panelists each budget a couple of hours a week to try new features before a deadline forces them to.
Closing Q&A: attendees ask about burnout from tool-switching, and the panel's shared advice to standardize a personal 'default stack' instead of adopting every new tool.
